label: D1 after an unrewarded common a2->S2 trial, when the agent stays with a2 (early/mid episode)
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO or D2), and almost only when the reward input is 0 and the previous trial was a2 with a common transition to S2 (99% of mass has prev_reward 0; all mass with known previous trial has prev_action 2 and prev_common 1). That core observed predicate gives dev P 0.47 / R 0.73 / F1 0.57 / mass recall 0.83. Precision improves when the agent then chooses a2 again (action == 2 at D1 is the agent own upcoming choice, which it computes; F1 0.64) and when ep_trial < 70 (the feature is silent after trial ~80 and weakens across the episode; F1 0.74, P 0.82). The model value at these steps is in a narrow middle band (7.1-7.5) and the policy logit mildly favours a2 (-4.4 to -1.5). Missed mass (~17%) is mostly rel -3 D1 steps where the window does not contain the previous trial, plus tiny activations after rewarded trials. Does not fire after a1 trials, rare transitions, or rewarded trials. Recorded predicate uses action (marked FUTURE at D1) only as the agent own upcoming choice; no future random outcome is used.
